content.short: Discover Tonkeeper, a highly optimized Web3 Wallets protocol focusing on software wallets to drive mass adoption in Web3.
content.description: Tonkeeper is a leading non-custodial cryptocurrency wallet designed for the TON (The Open Network) ecosystem. Operating at the forefront of the Web3 Wallets sector, Tonkeeper redefines how users interact with software wallets. The protocol leverages the advanced capabilities of Ethereum to provide a seamless, non-custodial experience that guarantees user sovereignty. Its architecture is explicitly built for scale, accommodating high throughput and complex decentralized operations. With a strong commitment to open-source principles, Tonkeeper stands out as a crucial utility in the modern Web3 tech stack.
content.meta: Tonkeeper is redefining software wallets on Ethereum. Dive into detailed analytics and explore Tonkeeper directly on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
